rules.ug_units_to_graduate: A bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) requires a minimum of 120 semester units.
rules.ug_residence_units: At least 30 units must be earned in residence at SF State, including 24 upper-division units and 12 units in the major.
rules.ug_residence_ud_ge: Nine of the 30 residence units must be earned in upper-division General Education.
rules.ug_upper_division_units: At least 30 upper-division units (courses numbered 300-699) are required for the bachelor's degree.
rules.ug_max_community_college_units: At most 70 semester units of community college work count toward the degree.
rules.ug_max_extension_units: At most 24 semester units of extension and correspondence credit count toward the degree.
rules.ug_max_exam_units: At most 30 units by examination or evaluation count toward the degree.
rules.ug_max_cr_units: No more than 24 SF State units applied to the bachelor's degree may be graded CR (Credit). Major courses offered only as CR/NC don't count toward the 24.
rules.ug_max_685_units: At most 4 units of courses numbered 685 titled 'Projects in Teaching...' apply to the bachelor's degree.
rules.ug_min_gpa_graduation: Graduation requires a 2.0 GPA or better in combined cumulative, SF State, and major coursework.
rules.ug_ge_units: General Education requires at least 43 units.
rules.ug_ge_upper_division: Upper-division GE requires at least 9 units: one 3-unit course each in 2UD or 5UD (science/quantitative reasoning), 3UD (arts/humanities), and 4UD (social/behavioral sciences).
rules.ug_ge_ud_prereqs: Upper-division GE courses require 1A, 1B, 1C and Area 2 first; they're recommended after 60 units.
rules.ug_ge_area1: GE Area 1 (English Communication): at least 9 units, 3 each in 1A English Composition, 1B Critical Thinking, 1C Oral Communication.
rules.ug_ge_area3: GE Area 3 (Arts and Humanities): at least 6 units, 3 in Arts (3A) and 3 in Humanities (3B).
rules.ug_ge_area5: GE Area 5 (Physical and Biological Sciences): at least 7 units, including 3 in physical science and 3 in biological science (plus a 1-unit lab, 5C).
rules.ug_ge_table: GE requirement table: 1A 3, 1B 3, 1C 3, 2 3, 3A 3, 3B 3, 4 6, 5A 3, 5B 3, 5C 1, 6 (Ethnic Studies, LD or UD) 3, 2UD/5UD 3, 3UD 3, 4UD 3. Area 4 also covers U.S. History (USH).
rules.ug_gwar: Every bachelor's program requires a Graduation Writing Assessment Requirement (GWAR) course, marked 'GW' after the number, passed with C- or better.
rules.ug_sf_state_studies: Undergraduates must take courses covering all four SF State Studies areas: AERM, ESCA, GP and SJ. Courses may come from GE, major, minor or electives. Students with a verified AA-T/AS-T in a similar major are exempt.
rules.ug_american_institutions: American Institutions has two parts: U.S. History (USH) and U.S. and California Government (USG/CSLG).
rules.ug_complementary_studies: B.A. students may need at least 12 units of Complementary Studies outside the major's primary prefix.
rules.ug_declare_major: Students who enter as freshmen must declare a major by the time they complete 70 units.
rules.ug_major_gpa: The major requires a minimum 2.0 GPA; some majors set higher grade minimums.
rules.ug_major_ge_double_count: Any number of GE courses may also count toward the major, but their units count once toward the 120.
rules.ug_change_major_catalog: When you declare or change a major after admission, you follow the major requirements in effect at the time of the declaration/change.
rules.ug_minor_min_units: A minor requires at least 12 units; at least half must be taken at SF State and at least 6 units must be upper-division; 2.0 GPA in the minor; no major and minor in the same discipline.
rules.ug_minor_residence: At least half the minor's units must be taken at SF State and at least 6 must be upper-division.
rules.ug_time_limit: No general time limit for undergraduate units, but departments may require retaking major/minor/certificate courses taken more than 7 years before graduation.
rules.class_levels: Class level by earned units: Freshman 0-29, Sophomore 30-59, Junior 60-89, Senior 90+.
rules.ug_average_load: 15 units is an average full-time undergraduate semester load.
rules.normal_load: Normal load: undergraduates 12-15 units per fall/spring semester (8 in summer); graduates 9-12 (7 in summer). Expect two hours of preparation for every hour of class.
rules.ug_max_units_priority_registration: During priority registration undergraduates can register for at most 19 units, including up to 8 wait-listed units.
rules.grad_max_units_registration: Graduate students can register for at most 16 units, including up to 9 wait-listed units.
rules.ug_max_units_academic_notice: Undergraduates on academic notice may enroll in at most 13 units (starting with their second semester on notice).
rules.ug_max_units_summer: Summer maximums (undergraduate): 7 units in a 5-week session, 9 in an 8-week, 12 in a 10-week, 14 across all summer sessions combined (including 8 wait-listed).
rules.ug_exceed_max_units: To exceed the maximum, undergraduates need a cumulative SF State GPA of 3.0+ and an approved Exceed Maximum Units Petition (major advisor, department chair, college dean).
rules.ug_25_units: Enrolling in 25 or more units in one semester requires approval from the advisor, college dean, and Dean of Undergraduate Education and Academic Planning.
rules.intl_min_units: International (F-1) students must carry at least 12 units (undergraduate) or 8 units (graduate) each fall and spring.
rules.fa_enrollment_status: Financial-aid enrollment status: full-time = 12 units, three-quarter time = 9-11, half-time = 6-8.
rules.grad_full_time: Graduate full-time in fall/spring: 6.1+ units for fee purposes, 8+ for financial aid and international students; typical load 9-12.
rules.grad_max_units: Graduate maximum with advisor permission is 16 units; more than 16 needs GPA 3.25+ and a petition; post-baccalaureate students normally can't exceed 18 units.
rules.grad_max_units_summer: Graduate summer maximums: 6 units in a 5-week session, 9 in an 8- or 10-week session, 11 across all summer sessions.
rules.va_full_time: For VA benefits, undergraduates must complete 12+ units and graduates 8+ upper-division/graduate units (9+ if any lower-division) per term for maximum benefits.
rules.add_deadline: Courses can be added with an instructor-issued permission number during the first three weeks of the semester.
rules.drop_first_three_weeks: During the first three weeks, courses can be dropped without restriction or penalty; drops don't appear on the transcript or count toward the withdrawal limit.
rules.withdraw_weeks_4_12: Weeks 4-12: withdrawal requires serious and compelling reasons plus instructor and department chair approval; results in a W (not in GPA).
rules.withdraw_week_13_on: Week 13 to end of instruction: withdrawal only for circumstances clearly beyond the student's control (e.g., accident, serious illness), with documentation and instructor, chair and dean approval.
rules.ug_withdraw_limit: Undergraduates may withdraw from at most 18 units over their entire SF State career.
rules.withdraw_deadline: All withdrawal requests must be submitted by the last day of instruction.
rules.readmission_three_semesters: Students who don't enroll for three consecutive semesters (excluding summer) must apply for readmission.
rules.audit: Auditors pay the same fees; switching audit to credit must happen by the add deadline; credit to audit isn't allowed after week 2.
rules.leave_of_absence: Continuing students can be absent up to two consecutive fall/spring semesters without losing eligibility; a Planned Educational Leave is needed for 3+ consecutive semesters.
rules.grade_points: Grade points per unit: A 4.0, A- 3.7, B+ 3.3, B 3.0, B- 2.7, C+ 2.3, C 2.0, C- 1.7, D+ 1.3, D 1.0, D- 0.7, F 0, IC 0, WU 0. W, I, AU, RP, RD, CR, NC carry no grade points. There is no A+.
rules.gpa_formula: GPA = total grade points / total units attempted in A-F graded courses (adjusted by the course repeat policy).
rules.cr_definition: CR means A through C- work in an undergraduate course, or A through B- in a graduate course.
rules.grading_option_deadline: The deadline to change grading option (e.g., to CR/NC) is one week before the last day of instruction.
rules.grad_cr_limit: For a master's degree, at most 30% of Advancement to Candidacy units may be CR.
rules.incomplete: An Incomplete (I) requires passing work and normally 75%+ of coursework done. It must be made up within one calendar year, or it becomes IC, which counts as F.
rules.wu_grade: WU (unauthorized withdrawal) counts as a failing grade in the GPA.
rules.ug_repeat_rules: Undergraduates can't repeat a course passed with C or better (or CR) unless it's repeatable for credit. A course with a grade below C (including W, WU, etc.) may be repeated only once more.
rules.ug_grade_forgiveness: Up to 16 units of SF State coursework can be repeated for grade forgiveness (the lower grade is excluded from the GPA). It doesn't apply to academic dishonesty.
rules.ug_repeat_cap: After repeating 28 units of SF State coursework, undergraduates can't repeat more courses (except those repeatable for credit).
rules.repeat_default: Courses can't be repeated for additional credit unless the course description says so.
rules.grad_repeat: Graduate students can repeat a course graded below B- (or IC, W, WU) once, if the program permits. Both grades stay on the transcript and are averaged.
rules.ug_good_standing: Good academic standing means a 2.0 GPA or better.
rules.ug_academic_notice: An SF State or combined cumulative GPA below 2.0 puts an undergraduate on academic notice; a second semester below 2.0 makes them subject to disqualification (mandatory advising, registration hold).
rules.ug_disqualification: Disqualification happens if term GPA < 2.0 and cumulative GPA is below: 1.50 (freshman <30 units), 1.70 (sophomore 30-59), 1.85 (junior 60-89), 1.95 (senior 90+).
rules.ug_readmission_after_dq: Disqualified students must raise SF State and combined GPAs to 2.0 to be reinstated (SF State GPA via Open University).
rules.deans_list: Dean's List: 12+ A-F graded units completed in the semester with a semester GPA of 3.25 or better.
rules.latin_honors: Graduation honors by cumulative GPA: cum laude 3.50-3.69, magna cum laude 3.70-3.84, summa cum laude 3.85+. GPA is not rounded.
rules.grad_min_units: Minimum units: master's (M.A., M.S., M.P.H., M.M.) 30; M.F.A. 60; doctorates (Ed.D., D.P.T.) 60.
rules.grad_gpa: Graduate students need a 3.0 GPA in all post-baccalaureate SF State work and on the ATC; non-supervisory ATC courses need B- or better.
rules.grad_standing: Graduate students go on academic notice/probation if overall, SF State or semester GPA falls below 3.0.
rules.grad_seven_year_limit: Master's and doctoral degrees must be completed within seven years; one extension of up to one year may be requested.
rules.grad_progress: Graduate students must complete at least 6 units each year (excluding summer).
rules.grad_residence: At least 21 of 30 master's units must be taken in residence (proportionally more for larger programs).
rules.grad_transfer_units: At most 9 semester units of transfer/CPaGE coursework may apply to a 30-unit graduate program (more for 45+ unit programs).
rules.grad_open_university: At most 6 Open University units may apply to a 30-unit master's (no more than 12 for larger degrees).
rules.ug_grad_courses_as_undergrad: Up to 9 upper-division or 12 graduate units (max 12 total) taken as an undergraduate can count toward a graduate program if not used for the bachelor's degree.
rules.scholars_units: SF State Scholars (combined bachelor's + master's) requires at least 150 units total (120 + 30).
rules.course_numbering: Course numbers: 0-99 remedial/non-credit (don't count toward graduation), 100-299 lower-division, 300-699 upper-division, 700-899 graduate, 900-999 doctoral, 9000-9999 professional CEU.
rules.prereq_asterisk: An asterisk (*) after a prerequisite means it is enforced at registration; others may be enforced by the instructor through add/drop.
rules.cross_listed: A cross-listed course can't be taken for credit a second time under another prefix.
